resume: DUB-1 is a generative dub techno machine: it plays by itself from power-on (chords into a tape echo, bass, kick, noise). You don't play it, you steer it: scale, filter, echo, mutes.

commandes.role: On a layer's page, lowers its level by 5; with OCT+ together, mutes the layer or restores it.
On a layer's page, raises its level by 5; with OCT- together, mutes the layer or restores it.
Space page (echo, time, feedback, reverb); again, Echo page.
Tapped, opens PERFORM: the knobs become Filter, Wet, Energy, Duck, and the keys mute or solo layers. Held: turns Lock on or off.
Chord layer page; again, its sound page.
Bass layer page; again, its sound page.
Opens the Chords page (eight upcoming chords); held, launches the next chord.
Setup page; held, saves the eight pieces.
Dub page (filter, movement); again, Key page (tempo, root, mode, swing). Held + SELECT: tempo.
Noise page (the crackle); again, Noise space.
Pings layer page; again, its sound page.
Drums layer page; again, its sound page, then the Pattern page (five tracks of sixteen steps).
Tapped, dub hold: the echo repeats what it holds forever; again to release. Held, opens the effects grid.
Previous or next page, in the order of the panel buttons.
On a layer's page, changes its voice; on Noise, its character; elsewhere, the center screen (ripples, scope, spectrum).
The scale: each key adds its note or removes it. The root stays, and at least three notes.

gestes: REC held: effects grid (sixteen effects on the white keys).
SEL held: Lock, each phrase keeps the kick, percussion and bass plan.
A layer button held: small variation of the layer's sound; held 1.5 s: new draw.
